items.title: Nov 10, 2026: HumHonCultureCon Movie Event: Metropolis (1927) at Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library
items.description:
Over the 2026–27 school year, the SJSU's Humanities Honors Program is pleased to bring you the Humanities Honors Cultural Connections film series — or HumHonCultureCon, for short! — FREE movie events open to the campus community and general public that explore the interconnectedness of global cultures and that relate to material taught in Humanities Honors courses.

Each HumHonCultureCon event will feature extras and surprises. This one is a joint event and is also part of the Campus Reading Program's I, Robot film series.
items.location_name: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library
items.address: 150 E. San Fernando Street, San Jose, CA 95112

items.title: Nov 12, 2026: Gen AI Pitch Competition | Hosted by Cloudtech x Silicon Valley SBDC x AWS at Mitchell Park Community Center
items.description: Hosted by Silicon Valley SBDC in partnership with AWS and Cloudtech, this exciting event gives small businesses, startups, and entrepreneurs the opportunity to showcase their AI-driven innovations and compete for up to $25,000 in AWS partner funding!
